title: Make Playbook: The Make mistake that's costing you margin
caption:
The Make mistake that's costing you margin

The old way vs. what actually works now:
1️⃣ Open a scenario — Webhook or app trigger — the visual canvas shows every step as a bubble you can actually trace.
2️⃣ Draw if/else paths — High-ticket leads right, low-ticket left — the branching Zapier charges premium for, standard here.
3️⃣ Filter before action — Only qualified leads move forward. Junk never burns an email send or an operation credit.
4️⃣ Run 10x free — Test runs cost nothing while you're still building — most solopreneurs never hit the free cap.
